sections.text: Every season, talented players get cut.
Not from a lack of talent. From a lack of a plan.
Meet VarFooty. It scores your varsity readiness, one number across every skill that matters.
Train with drills that are actually coached. A setup, an action, a measurement, and a cue.
Log your result, and your score moves.
It builds your roadmap automatically. Week by week, ordered by your biggest gaps, straight to tryout day.
Fuel like an athlete, with real U S D A nutrition tracked to the gram.
Because varsity is built in the kitchen too.
And your A I coach knows everything. Your readiness, your gaps, your plan, your nutrition.
So the advice is always yours. Never generic.
Readiness. Training. Nutrition. Coaching. Everything a player needs, in one app.
VarFooty. Train with purpose. Make varsity.
